title: Oracle separation of BQP with NP access from PH with PromiseBQP access

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard relativized quantum/classical/promise complexity models and imported Raz–Tal Forrelation, random-projection and query bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported background statements and full original bibliography retained. Every source-local quantum simulation, concentration/restriction, oracle construction and diagonalization proof retained, including corrected v4 Lemma53.

core_obligations: Establish the corrected v4 sparse-oracle quantum-to-classical simulation.
Apply it to the full Forrelation-of-ORs lower-bound construction.
Construct an oracle separating BQP with NP access from PH with PromiseBQP access, retaining the stronger promise-class conclusion.
difficulty_reason: A non-routine sparse-oracle simulation converts quantum queries into classical queries on a Forrelation-of-ORs construction, yielding the converse oracle-order separation. Complete corrected v4 sparse simulation and the oracle construction are retained.
